name: Angerie Champion (3pp)
source: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition
book: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition

facets.bk: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition

body:
The champion form of angerie still serves its purpose as guardian within the king’s castle. After the Purge, it is one of only a handful of monsters still allowed within the Mad King’s throne room.

Monster Trainer Spells
Monstorin Stats

VALOREN
CR 20

XP 307,200
NG Medium outsider (angel, extraplanar, good)
Init +10; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +26
Aura protective aura

DEFENSE

AC 41, touch 16, flat-footed 35 (+6 Dex, +25 natural; +4 deflection vs. evil)
hp 217 (15d10+135)
Fort +20, Ref +11, Will +13; +4 vs. poison, +4 resistance vs. evil
Defensive Abilities medium fortification, uncanny dodge; DR 10/evil; Immune acid, cold, petrification; Resist fire 15; SR 25

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft., fly 100 ft. (good)
Melee slam +27 (1d8+18)
Ranged +2 composite longbow of endless ammunition +22/+17 (1d8+14)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 19th)

5/day—aid, continual flame, detect evil, discern lies (DC 23), dispel evil (DC 24), dispel magic, holy aura (DC 27), holy smite (DC 23), holy word (DC 26), invisibility (self only), plane shift (DC 24), protection from evil, remove curse, remove disease
3/day—cure light wounds, see invisibility
1/day—blade barrier (DC 25), mass cure moderate wounds
1/week—foresight

STATISTICS

Str 34, Dex 23, Con 27, Int 22, Wis 22, Cha 29
Base Atk +15; CMB +27; CMD 43
Feats Alertness, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Point-Blank Shot, Rapid Shot Toughness, Weapon Focus (longbow)
Skills Acrobatics +24, Craft (any one) +24, Diplomacy +27, Fly +28, Intimidate +27, Knowledge (planes) +26, Knowledge (religion) +21, Perception +28, Sense Motive +28, Stealth +24, swim +8
Languages Celestial, Draconic, Infernal; truespeech

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Protective Aura (Su)

Against attacks made or effects created by evil creatures, this ability provides a +4 deflection bonus to AC and a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws to anyone within 20 feet of the angel. Otherwise, it functions as a magic circle against evil effect and a lesser globe of invulnerability, both with a radius of 20 feet (caster level equals angel’s HD). The defensive benefits from the circle are not included in an angel’s statistics block.
